About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

À propos du poste

Ce poste de direction est essentiel : il consiste à construire et à faire passer à l’échelle les partenariats d’Anthropic avec les cabinets de conseil, les intégrateurs de systèmes mondiaux (GSI) et les boutiques partenaires nativement IA en France.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec l’équipe commerciale pour que les clients adoptent l’IA grâce à nos partenaires.

Ce poste est un poste de construction, et non de gestion. Compte tenu du stade de développement d’Anthropic, nous recherchons un profil qui a déjà fait ses preuves en faisant passer des partenariats de zéro à des moteurs de revenus à grande échelle, un profil qui a bâti ces relations de A à Z, et non simplement hérité de relations existantes pour les gérer.

Responsabilités

  • Partenariats et exécution
    • Vous collaborerez étroitement avec l’équipe commerciale pour comprendre comment les partenaires peuvent soutenir l’adoption de Claude par les clients.
    • Vous accompagnerez les partenaires dans la création de solutions clients reproductibles, répondant à des cas d’usage précis dans de nombreux secteurs : services financiers, santé, distribution, industrie, secteur public et services professionnels.
  • Performance et pilotage des indicateurs clés (KPI)
    • Vous portez la responsabilité des indicateurs clés de performance et vous les pilotez : revenus influencés par les partenaires, livraison réalisée par les partenaires, nombre de personnes consultantes formées et certifiées.
    • Chaque deal influencé par votre portefeuille de partenaires doit être conçu pour la réussite du client et la croissance de sa valeur à long terme. Vous définirez des critères de réussite pour les comptes communs, veillerez à la qualité de la mise en œuvre et de l’accompagnement à l’adoption, et mettrez en place des boucles de retour d’expérience favorisant l’amélioration continue.
    • Vous rendrez compte de la santé des partenariats, de leur avancement et de leurs résultats commerciaux, en vous appuyant sur des analyses fondées sur les données.
  • Développement du marché et construction de la marque
    • Vous renforcerez la notoriété de la marque Anthropic en France grâce à des relations stratégiques avec les partenaires.
    • Vous élaborerez et déploierez des stratégies de mise sur le marché (GTM) propres à chaque marché, adaptées aux pratiques commerciales et aux nuances culturelles locales.
    • Vous composerez avec les enjeux locaux de réglementation, de conformité et de souveraineté des données.
    • Vous créerez un avantage concurrentiel grâce aux capacités singulières des partenaires et à des propositions de valeur élaborées en commun.

Votre profil

Ce poste pourrait vous convenir si vous réunissez les atouts suivants :

  • Vous avez l’esprit d’initiative et le goût de construire : vous êtes à l’aise pour partir de zéro et créer des partenariats d’envergure.
  • Vous maîtrisez l’anglais et le français.
  • Vous comptez au moins 8 ans d’expérience dans les partenariats technologiques à destination des entreprises, idéalement dans le cloud, l’IA/ML ou les activités de plateforme.
  • Vous avez une culture de la donnée, tournée vers les résultats mesurables et l’atteinte des KPI, et un historique avéré de revenus additionnels générés grâce aux partenariats dans la région.
  • Vous avez démontré votre capacité à assurer la réussite des clients et la protection de la marque via les canaux partenaires.
  • Vous avez l’esprit de compétition : la victoire et la différenciation sont votre moteur.
  • Vous avez une approche collaborative et savez travailler de façon transversale avec les équipes commerciales, produit, marketing et régionales.
  • Vous nourrissez une vraie passion pour l’IA et vous vous reconnaissez dans la mission d’Anthropic : développer une IA bénéfique.

Relations de travail

Votre rattachement hiérarchique se fera auprès de la direction des partenariats internationaux, tandis que votre activité quotidienne sera pilotée par la personne responsable des partenariats EMEA Sud. Vous travaillerez également en étroite collaboration avec la direction commerciale régionale d’Anthropic et ses Account Executives, ainsi qu’avec les équipes Customer Success et Applied AI de la région.

Lieu et déplacements

Ce poste est basé à Paris, en France, avec des déplacements à prévoir pour rencontrer les partenaires et les clients.

About the Role

This is a critical leadership role responsible for building and scaling Anthropic's consulting, GSIs and AI-native boutique partners in France.
You will be working closely with the sales team to make sure customers are adopting AI through our partners.


This is a builder role, not a manager role. Given Anthropic's stage, we need someone who has proven they can take partnerships from zero to scaled revenue engines — someone who has built these relationships from the ground up, not just inherited and managed existing ones.

Responsibilities:

  • Partnerships and execution:
    • You will engage closely with the sales team to understand how partners can support customer Claude adoption
    • You will guide partners in creating repeatable customer solutions that address specific use cases across industries including financial services, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, public sector, and professional services.
  • Performance and KPI ownership:
    • Own and drive key performance indicators, partner-influenced revenue, partner delivery, consultants trained and certified
    • Every deal influenced through your partner portfolio must be architected for customer success and long-term value expansion. You will establish success criteria for joint accounts, ensure proper implementation and adoption support, and create feedback loops that drive continuous improvement.
    • Report on partnership health, progress, and commercial outcomes with data-driven insights
  • Market Development & Brand Building
    • Amplify the Anthropic brand in France strategic partner relationships
    • Develop and execute market-specific GTM strategies adapted to local business practices and cultural nuances
    • Navigate local regulatory, compliance, and data sovereignty considerations
    • Create competitive differentiation through unique partner capabilities and joint value propositions

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • Builder mentality — comfortable starting from zero and creating scaled partnerships

Fluent in English and French

  • 8+ years of experience in enterprise technology partnerships, ideally within cloud, AI/ML, or platform businesses
  • Data-driven mindset with focus on measurable outcomes and KPI attainment. Track record of driving incremental revenues through partnerships in the region
  • History of delivering exceptional customer success and brand protection through partner channels
  • Competitive drive — obsessed with winning and creating differentiation
  • Collaborative approach with ability to work cross-functionally across sales, product, marketing, and regional teams
  • Passion for AI and alignment with Anthropic's mission of beneficial AI development

Working Relationships

You will formally report to the International Partnerships leader, while your day-to-day work will be led by our South EMEA Partnerships lead. You will also partner closely with Anthropic's regional sales leader and their Account Executives, as well as the in-region Customer Success and Applied AI teams.

Location and Travel

This role will be based in Paris, France with travel expected to engage with partners and customers externally.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
€220.000—€260.000 EUR

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Account Executive - Figma Weave (London, United Kingdom)
description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

We’re building the next chapter of AI-native craft and creativity - where craft and technology meet. Our unified platform bridges the gap between AI capabilities and human creativity, and lets professional creatives and designers harness the power of the world’s leading AI models without losing precision, expression, or soul. Together, we’re building tools that help people move faster without sacrificing quality, precision, or craft — a platform where AI supports creativity instead of flattening it.

We are looking for Account Executives who are excited to help creative teams explore what’s possible with generative AI. Figma Weave is a startup within Figma, and you will play a key role in winning new business while helping contribute to how our team sells. You will work closely with Figma Account Executives and cross-functional partners to understand customer needs, demonstrate relevant workflows, and guide opportunities from first conversation through close. This is an opportunity to get hands-on with a fast-evolving product, work with exciting logos as they embrace GenAI, and help shape a growing team.

This is a full time role that is based in our London hub.

What you’ll do at Figma Weave:

  • Create and manage a pipeline of new business through outbound prospecting, inbound engagement, and Figma AE introductions to consistently exceed sales targets
  • Prioritize your book and time to focus on top priorities amongst change
  • Apply effective discovery and value-selling techniques to uncover business challenges, build relationships with key decision-makers, and connect Weave to customer priorities
  • Partner with your customers through demos to help identify high business priority use-cases and inspire what’s possible in Weave. Build your product knowledge through hands-on use of Weave
  • Manage proposals, business cases, and negotiations, partnering with legal, procurement, finance, Figma sellers, and security teams to move deals forward
  • Collaborate with customer success and workflow advocates to prepare thoughtful handoffs and identify opportunities for customers to grow with Weave
  • Maintain accurate pipeline and forecasts, share customer feedback, and help develop sales practices and resources as the product and team evolve

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

  • Experience managing the full sales cycle from high-growth startups to F1000 companies, including prospecting, discovery, negotiation, and close
  • A track record of exceeding sales goals and generating your own pipeline of new business
  • Demonstrated experience using discovery to connect customer challenges to business value
  • Experience learning a technical product and delivering customer demos that explain its value and capabilities
  • Excited by working with other sellers and cross-functional partners to manage customer opportunities and buying processes

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience working in creative industries and/or selling to creative teams
  • Worked at startup in hypergrowth
  • Familiarity with post-production, VFX, Film, creative workflows, or Figma / Weave itself

At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At Figma we celebrate and support our differences. We know employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, our product and our community to flourish. Figma is an equal opportunity workplace - we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity/expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to apply for a role, participate in the interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require accommodation, please reach out to accommodations-ext@figma.com. These modifications enable an individual with a disability to have an equal opportunity not only to get a job, but successfully perform their job tasks to the same extent as people without disabilities.

Examples of accommodations include but are not limited to:

  • Holding interviews in an accessible location
  • Enabling closed captioning on video conferencing
  • Ensuring all written communication be compatible with screen readers
  • Changing the mode or format of interviews

To ensure the integrity of our hiring process and facilitate a more personal connection, we require all candidates keep their cameras on during video interviews. Additionally, if hired you will be required to attend in person onboarding.

By applying for this job, the candidate acknowledges and agrees that any personal data contained in their application or supporting materials will be processed in accordance with Figma's Candidate Privacy Notice.

Application limits: To help candidates focus on the opportunities most relevant to their skills and experience, Figma limits the number and frequency of applications. These limits apply to all roles:

  • Candidates may submit up to 5 applications during any rolling 30-day period.
  • Candidates may not reapply to the same role while an application is active or within 90 days of receiving a rejection.

Once the applicable days has passed, candidates are welcome to apply again.

title: Business Development Manager, Product Partnerships
description:
About the Team

We are hiring a Product Partnerships Manager based in Germany with primary responsibility for Germany. You will own some of OpenAI’s most important business development and partnerships in the German market while contributing to broader EMEA and international priorities. The role is responsible for identifying, developing, and executing partnership strategies that accelerate adoption of OpenAI’s products across enterprise, developer, and consumer channels.

About the Role

You will identify and manage relationships with strategic product partners in Germany and on cross-border opportunities, ranging from global technology platforms to regional champions, including enterprise software vendors, telcos, cloud providers, and government-aligned organizations. This is a deeply cross-functional role requiring close collaboration with Product, Engineering, GTM, Legal, and Policy teams. Although the role has clear accountability for Germany, team priorities may evolve, so you must be ready to take on other markets, verticals, or partnership types.

Please note that this role is based out of our Munich office, with 3 days a week required in the office.

In this role, you will:

  • Own product partnership strategy and execution for Germany, driving end-to-end partnership sourcing and delivery in the market while contributing to broader EMEA and international priorities.

  • Negotiate and close strategic local and cross-border deals across commercial terms, product scope, data/privacy, brand/marketing, incentives, and expansion paths.

  • Over time, lead senior partner relationships: build trust, align on joint value props, and manage complexity.

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, GTM, Legal, Policy, and regional counterparts to align roadmaps, navigate constraints, and execute partnership initiatives.

  • Bring deep knowledge of Germany and a strong point of view on country and sub-region differences across EMEA, informing prioritization, positioning, and partner selection. Apply that judgment flexibly when supporting opportunities beyond Germany or in new verticals.

  • Define success metrics and use analytical judgment to assess progress, surface risks, and communicate outcomes to internal stakeholders.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • 10+ years of experience in product partnerships or partnership business development within the technology industry.

  • Fluency in English and German.

  • Demonstrated success leading high-impact local and international partnerships involving major technology partners, including complex cross-border work.

  • Deep understanding of the German market, combined with experience operating across multiple countries and international markets.

  • Product-savvy with the ability to engage technical stakeholders credibly and influence product direction and roadmap tradeoffs.

  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and executive presence.

  • Strong analytical instincts and comfort using data to inform decisions and communicate impact.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, highly ambiguous environment, operate both independently and collaboratively, and adapt quickly across changing markets, verticals, and partnership types.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link.

OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy

At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

title: Technical Account Manager (APJ)
description:
About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role

We’re seeking a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to be the primary technical partner for our Team & customers after the sale, helping them adopt, operate, and get long-term value from Supabase.

At Supabase, TAMs are the technical owners of their assigned accounts, working closely with our most valuable customers to:

  • Understand each customer’s architecture, use cases, constraints, and goals.

  • Validate deployments and guide customers through onboarding and early success.

  • Proactively surface risks and optimization opportunities before they become incidents.

  • Coordinate internal teams on complex escalations and drive root cause analysis.

  • Align Supabase capabilities with the customer’s roadmap.

Successful TAMs are proactive, technically credible, and customer-first. TAM is a relationship, not a response channel: you’ll act as an extension of your customers’ teams and advocate on their behalf within Supabase.

You’ll be joining our Success team, where you will be expected to lead and innovate around the following areas of responsibility:

Technical Ownership & Onboarding

Act as the technical owner for your assigned accounts, documenting environments, mapping dependencies, and tracking technical risks.

Validate architecture and deployment plans after the sale, guide initial configuration and best practices, and make sure customers understand platform capabilities and limitations.

Help customers reach early success milestones to shorten time to value and reduce early friction.

Proactive Technical Guidance

Regularly review customer environments and usage patterns to identify scalability, performance, reliability, security, and compliance risks and opportunities.

Plan upgrades and lifecycle events, and run architecture reviews for upcoming initiatives, including capacity and growth planning, feature readiness, and early identification of technical blockers.

Escalation & Collaboration

Coordinate across Support and Engineering on complex or high-impact issues. TAMs are not frontline support, but provide the context, prioritization, and follow-through that drive resolution, root cause analysis, and preventative action.

Serve as the voice of the customer to Engineering and Product, sharing specific, reproducible feedback on recurring pain points and taking part in beta and early access programs.

Partner with Sales and Customer Success on account health and retention, with technical input on renewals, expansions, and evaluations, and early flags on risks to satisfaction.

Preferred Experience

6+ years of relevant work experience in engineering, SRE, technical consulting, or similar, including operating production systems under real constraints.

Strong technical depth across database internals, scalability, security posture, and infrastructure tradeoffs. You understand a customer’s architecture as well as they do, without escalating every question.

A proactive mindset: you spot risks and optimization opportunities before the customer does, and you treat your accounts like a personal portfolio.

Sound escalation judgment: you know when to escalate, when to resolve internally, and how to communicate clearly under pressure without creating noise.

Very strong communication skills. TAMs explain complex issues to non-technical executives and root causes to senior engineers, often in the same day.

Awareness of how TAM performance shows up in retention and NRR, including surfacing expansion signals and renewal risks early.

Experience working in async or globally distributed teams.

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

  • ~400 team members

  • 60+ countries

  • 20+ languages spoken

  • Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

  • 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Enterprise Account Manager, France
description:
Contentsquare is the all-in-one experience intelligence platform designed to be easily used by anyone who cares about digital journeys. With our flexible and scalable platform, organizations quickly get a deep understanding of their customers’ whole online journey.
We are a global leader in the experience analytics space, with a growing presence across 15 offices worldwide. We’re here to stay—and we’re looking for team members who are excited to drive impact and help us scale even further.
Our aim is to create an inclusive workplace where everyone learns and succeeds. Contentsquare has built a community of individuals who are daring, understanding, and deliberate. We invite you to join us in making the complex simpler—for our customers, their customers, and each other.
Important note: Be careful of scammers pretending to be from Contentsquare. We will never ask for money or contact you through random texts. Any communication from our in house Talent Acquisition team will only ever come from our contentsquare.com or @contentsquare-ext.com domain. For more information, visit our careers blog.

About the role

As an Enterprise Account Manager based in Paris, you will drive growth across France enterprise accounts by expanding existing customers, and winning new business. You will manage the full sales cycle for Contentsquare’s Experience Intelligence platform, building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and positioning our technology against complex business challenges.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the full sales cycle from prospecting through close, onboarding, and expansion.
  • Build lasting relationships with C-suite and senior stakeholders across Ecommerce, Marketing, Product, Analytics, and Technology.
  • Generate pipeline through prospecting, inbound leads, referrals, networking, events, and partnerships.
  • Develop customer-specific value propositions and effective account strategies.
  • Collaborate with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, Leadership, and global teams.
  • Support successful onboarding, adoption, and account growth.
  • Maintain accurate forecasts and strong CRM hygiene.

About you:

  • 4+ years experience in enterprise SaaS, technology sales, or complex solution selling.
  • Experience selling to senior executives in multi-stakeholder environments.
  • A track record of winning new business and successfully expanding existing accounts.
  • Strong commercial, presentation, communication, and negotiation skills.
  • Creative problem-solving skills and a collaborative approach.
  • Experience managing pipelines, forecasting, and extended sales teams.
  • Fluent French and business level English language required.

Important note: Be careful of scammers pretending to be from Contentsquare. We will never ask for money or contact you through random texts. Any communication from our in house Talent Acquisition team will only ever come from our contentsquare.com or @contentsquare-ext.com domain. For more information, visit our careers blog.

日本法人について / Contentsquare in Japan

2022年4月に日本法人を設立して以来、さまざまな業界のエンタープライズ企業から信頼されるパートナーへと成長してきました。現在は、カントリーマネージャーの堀井憲一郎が日本事業を率いています。約18名のメンバーが、営業（AE・SDR）、プリセールス、カスタマーサクセス、マーケティング、パートナーセールスの各チームで、お客様のデジタルトランスフォーメーションを支援しています。ソニー、三井住友カード、カシオ、ベルーナ、ソフトバンクをはじめ、国内60社以上のエンタープライズ企業にご利用いただいています。

Since opening our Japan entity in April 2022, we have grown into a trusted partner for enterprise companies across many industries. The Japan business is led by Country Manager Kenichiro Horii. Our team of around 18 people covers sales (AE and SDR), presales, customer success, marketing and partner sales, helping customers with their digital transformation. We work with more than 60 enterprise customers in Japan, including Sony, SMBC Card, Casio, Belluna and SoftBank.

ポジション概要 / About the job

東京オフィスを拠点に、APJカスタマーサクセス責任者（Head of Customer Success, APJ）の直属として、日本のエンタープライズ顧客を担当していただきます。導入から活用定着、契約更新・拡大まで、お客様に一貫して伴走するポジションです。お客様および日本チームとのコミュニケーションは日本語、上長およびAPJ・グローバルチームとは主に英語です。

Based in our Tokyo office and reporting to the Head of Customer Success, APJ, you will own a portfolio of enterprise customers in Japan. You will guide them all the way from onboarding through adoption, renewal and expansion. Customer work and the Japan team operate in Japanese. Your manager and the APJ and global teams work mainly in English.

title: Sales Development Leader,  Singapore
description:
About the team

OpenAI’s Enterprise Go-To-Market organization helps the world’s largest companies adopt and scale our AI platform across their business—from ChatGPT Enterprise to our developer platform and APIs.

We partner with organizations across Financial Services, Life Sciences, and Retail to build new AI-powered customer experiences, transform operations, and reimagine how work gets done in highly regulated and technically complex environments. As adoption accelerates through pilots, experimentation, and developer-led use cases, the GTM team turns that momentum into durable, enterprise-wide deployments.

Sales Development sits at the front of this motion—where technical curiosity becomes executive engagement and OpenAI’s enterprise relationships begin.

About the role

We are hiring a Sales Development Manager to lead a team of SDRs supporting our Large Enterprise business across APAC. Reporting into Sales Development leadership, this role will be responsible for coaching and developing a high-performing team focused on generating qualified pipeline and creating strategic enterprise opportunities.

This is a foundational front-line leadership role within OpenAI’s enterprise GTM organization. You will help define how we engage prospective customers, convert product and developer interest into enterprise conversations, and scale repeatable outbound and inbound motions across some of the world’s largest organizations.

You will partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Solutions Engineering, Partnerships, and Strategy & Operations to drive pipeline generation and help shape the future of OpenAI’s enterprise growth engine.

In this role, you will

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of SDRs supporting Large Enterprise, Verticals, and Strategic Accounts across APAC

  • Drive high-quality pipeline generation through outbound prospecting, inbound qualification, account-based motions, and product-led signals

  • Establish strong operational rigor around activity metrics, conversion rates, pipeline quality, and execution consistency

  • Partner closely with Account Directors and enterprise sales leadership on territory planning, account prioritization, and opportunity development

  • Help define scalable SDR playbooks across outbound, inbound, ABM, partner-sourced, and product-led motions

  • Coach SDRs on executive communication, discovery, account research, and strategic prospecting

  • Build a high-performance, collaborative, and low-ego team culture focused on continuous improvement

  • Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Partnerships, Solutions Engineering, and Strategy & Operations to optimize pipeline generation efforts

  • Support hiring, onboarding, and ramping of new SDR talent as the organization scales

  • Bring market feedback and customer insights back into the broader GTM organization

You may thrive in this role if you

  • Have 6–10+ years of experience in sales, business development, or GTM roles

  • Bring experience managing SDRs or business development teams in enterprise SaaS or platform businesses

  • Have a strong understanding of enterprise prospecting, pipeline generation, and outbound strategy

  • Are highly operational and data-driven, with experience managing metrics, conversion funnels, and forecasting

  • Thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments with evolving processes and ambiguity

  • Have experience partnering closely with Enterprise Sales teams on strategic account development

  • Are an exceptional coach who knows how to develop early-career talent into high-performing sales professionals

  • Communicate effectively with both technical and executive stakeholders

  • Lead with high standards, accountability, and a low-ego mindset

  • Are excited about helping enterprises adopt transformative AI technologies
